vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Fatima taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Vy showed Carolina the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Marcus showed Ashley the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Carolina showed Nathan the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Nikolai showed Arjun the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Nikolai showed Petra the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Fatima drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Vy, Arjun, Mateus, Petra and Fatima met them at the door — 5 put down. Arjun, Mateus, Petra, Fatima are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Vy, Arjun, Mateus, Fatima and Nikolai met them at the door — 5 put down. Vy, Arjun, Mateus, Fatima, Nikolai are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fatima just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jesse just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Vy, Arjun, Ashley, Mateus and Petra met them at the door — 5 put down. Arjun, Ashley, Mateus, Petra are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateus just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
Nikolai: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Thabo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Irma, James and Thabo met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Irma, James, Thabo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ James, Lucas and Ursula met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Lucas is hurt.
🛡️ James, Thabo and Lucas met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Thabo didn't come back. James, Lucas are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Big Thing... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lucas, Brian and Ursula met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Lucas, Brian, Ursula are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
